## General Provisions
<ol>
<li>All buildings and structures erected and all uses of land in all districts established after the effective date of this Ordinance shall provide accessory parking and loading facilities as required under this section.</li>
<li>All off-street parking spaces required by this Ordinance shall be located on the same lots as the use it serves.</li>
<li>Owners of two or more uses or parcels of land may agree to jointly utilize the same parking spaces provided that satisfactory legal evidence is presented in the form of deeds, leases, or contract documents to establish such a joint area of use.</li>
<li>All yard area including driveways, except the required front yard for residential uses may be used for off-street parking. Garages and driveways may be considered as off-street parking spaces.</li>
<li>A plan, drawn to scale, indicating how the off-street parking and loading requirements are to be met, shall accompany an application for a building certificate. The plan shall show all elements necessary to indicate that the requirements are being fulfilled.</li>
<li>A parking space shall be an area ten (10) feet by eighteen (18) feet except for loading and unloading areas which shall be an area ten (10) feet by thirty-six (36) feet.</li>
<li>If the Off-Street Parking and Off-Street Loading Requirements listed in Section 7.2 and Section 7.3 are not used, approval of the number of off-street parking spaces and locations shall be made by motion, second, and favorable vote by three-fourths of the attending Village Board members as recommended by the Planning and Zoning Commission.</li>
<li>ADA-accessible parking space: Parking facilities for single-family, duplex, and mobile homes are exempt from the requirement. Spaces designated for the handicapped shall have minimum width of twelve feet (12) and provide a barrier free route to an accessible building entrance. Such space shall be designated with an upright sign exhibiting the universal symbol for accessibility by the handicapped. All such spaces shall be designed in compliance with the standards of the Americans with Disabilities Act.</li>
</ol>

## Off-Street Parking Requirements
At the time of construction, or enlargement of more than 50 percent of an existing structure or building or change in the use of land, off-street parking spaces and loading areas shall be provided, constructed, and maintained for all uses as follows:

```{r offstreet parking, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(knitr)
parking <- data.frame(
  "Use" = c("Single family, two family dwelling", "Apartments", "Efficiency and one-bedroom", "Two-bedrooms", "Three or more bedrooms", "Mobile Trailer Park", "Hotel and Motel", "Hospitals, nursing homes, rest homes, or similar uses", "Places of public assembly such as auditoriums, theaters, stadiums, community halls, churches, etc.", "Bowling Alley", "Retail sales department stores, restaurants, taverns, grocery stores, etc.", "Professional office establishments", "Manufacturing, wholesale warehouse and similar uses"),
  "min" = c("2 per dwelling unit", "", "1 per dwelling unit", "1.5 per dwelling unit", "2 per dwelling unit", "2 per trailer unit", "1 per rental unit plus 1 for every 4 employees", "1 for every 2.5 patient beds and 1 for each staff and employee on the largest shift", "1 for every 4 seats", "2 for each alley", "1 per 200 square feet of floor area as determined by exterior wall dimensions", "1 per 500 square feet of floor area as determined by exterior wall dimensions", "1 for every 2 employees on the largest working shift")
)
colnames(parking) <- c("Use", "Minimum Number of Parking Spaces")

knitr::kable(parking, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
             longtable = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F,
                   fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% 
  row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% 
  column_spec(1:2, width = "15em")

```

## Off-Street Loading Requirements
At the time of construction, alteration or enlargement of any structure or building except residences and farms having an aggregate gross floor area of 500 square feet or more, off-street loading areas (areas designated adjacent to buildings where trucks may loan and unload cargo) shall be provided and maintained for all uses as follows:

```{r offstreet loading, echo = FALSE}
loading <- data.frame(
  "Number" = c("One", "One"),
  "Loading" = c("500 square feet", "500 square feet"),
  "Gross" = c("for every 5,000 to 20,000 square feet", "for every 20,000 square feet or fraction thereof")
)
colnames(loading) <- c("Number", "Loading Area", "Gross Floor Area")

knitr::kable(loading, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
             longtable = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F,
                   fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% 
  row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% 
  column_spec(1:3, width = "15em")

```
